name: works-on-my-codex
description: Create and manually refresh a thin, project-specific Codex harness.

interface.shortDescription: Create and manually refresh a thin Codex project harness.
interface.longDescription: WOMC creates and refreshes a thin project harness when asked in natural language. On first application or an explicit update, it reviews project skills and visible tool connections once. An explicit update refreshes the Git marketplace and installed plugin before updating the current project harness. It preserves durable project context and does not register session-start hooks.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Works on My Codex harness in this project.
